findings.claim: Host responses produced during synchronized output are withheld until paint resumes, allowing a producer waiting for CPR before close to deadlock.
findings.evidence: Built DOM plus committed WASM: CSI ? 2026 h followed by CSI 6 n produced no onData callback while open; ESC[1;1R arrived only after CSI ? 2026 l. getResponse is called only inside _doRender.
findings.path: WTerm.write -> synchronizedOutput -> cancel render; Terminal response queue -> _doRender -> getResponse -> onData

findings.claim: An unterminated synchronized-output block suppresses all later rendering indefinitely.
findings.evidence: After CSI ? 2026 h plus NEVER-CLOSED, DOM text remained empty and synchronizedOutput stayed true after 5.2 seconds; additional writes did not paint.
findings.path: WTerm.write -> cancel timer/RAF with no recovery scheduler

findings.claim: Resize bypasses the synchronized-output hold and exposes a partial frame.
findings.evidence: CSI ? 2026 h plus PARTIAL left the DOM blank; term.resize(80,24) exposed PARTIAL before CSI ? 2026 l because resize unconditionally calls renderer.setup and _scheduleRender.

findings.claim: The user-facing DOM atomic-render fix has no regression test that fails when the fix is removed.
findings.evidence: In a scratch HEAD copy, replacing dom/src/wterm.ts with origin/main while retaining all PR tests left core 32/32 and DOM 33/33 green.
findings.path: PR tests -> parser/WASM getter only; no DOM scheduling assertion

findings.claim: The new public synchronizedOutput methods are missing from required package and web documentation.
findings.evidence: TerminalCore and WasmBridge export synchronizedOutput, while core README and docs core/API surfaces have zero synchronizedOutput or mode-2026 entries.
findings.path: TerminalCore/WasmBridge public API -> package README and docs API reference

findings.claim: Cancelling after the timeout callback has promoted work to requestAnimationFrame leaves a late paint.
findings.evidence: _cancelScheduledRender clears both _renderTimer and rafId, and destroy uses the same helper; focused cancellation drive showed no late frame.

findings.claim: GhosttyCore must implement the new method for source compatibility.

findings.path: TerminalCore optional method -> GhosttyCore -> WTerm optional chaining
